主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, which is a report to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) under U.S. securities laws. The filing includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, with a principal amount of $5,200,000. The Notes are linked to the EquityCompass Equity Risk Management Strategy and are due on February 8, 2013. The filing also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the Notes under Canadian and New York law. The report was filed on January 10, 2012, and the settlement date for the Notes is January 10, 2012. The filing is part of the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
